title: Executable diagnostic snippets and priority telemetry scorer
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds executable diagnostic snippets in the incident Slack thread and a scoring model that ranks telemetry keys by likely causal relevance. Improves on-call turnaround for triage by surfacing runnable checks and prioritized traces.
description:
Motivation: On incoming alerts responders often need small, safe diagnostic commands and a short prioritized list of telemetry keys to inspect. This PR introduces two complementary features: (1) executable diagnostic snippets attached to contextual alert summaries (one-click copy/run code blocks tuned per service), and (2) a lightweight priority telemetry scorer that ranks traces, metrics, and logs keys by likely causal relevance using heuristics + a small trained logistic model.

Summary of changes: add a new embeddings-backed snippet index, a snippet authoring UI + templating engine, telemetry-scoring service with REST endpoint, alert enrichment pipeline updates to attach top-5 telemetry keys and top-3 snippets, and keyboard-friendly Slack actions to run or copy snippets.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc: ENG-1209 reviewed and linked
- [x] Add snippet schema, validation and safe-run sandbox gating
- [x] Implement telemetry scorer service and config flags
- [x] Wire alert enrichment to attach results to incident threads
- [x] End-to-end tests for snippet safety and scorer stability
- [x] E2E manual verification on staging with SLO-team
- [x] Docs + example snippet templates committed

Commits (high level):
- feat(snippets): initial schema, templating and indexer
- feat(telemetry-scorer): model training helpers and REST endpoint
- feat(enrichment): attach scorer output and snippet refs to alert payload
- feat(ui): add snippet authoring modal and run/copy actions
- test: add unit + integration tests for sandbox gating and scorer
- ci: update pipeline to run scorer unit tests and integration smoke tests

Files changed (high level):
- incident-bot/services/snippets/*: schema, indexer, templates, validation hooks
- incident-bot/services/telemetry_scorer/*: trainer, REST API, feature transforms
- incident-bot/enrichment/pipeline.py: attach telemetry keys and snippet refs
- incident-bot/ui/modals/snippet_authoring.jsx: new authoring modal and example templates
- incident-bot/slack/actions.py: run/copy actions, permission gating
- tests/*: unit + integration tests
- docs/oncall/snippets.md: example usage and safety guidelines

Review conversation (high level):
- Liam Chen: "Nice work. Two high-level asks: tighten sandbox execution limits (timeout/memory) and make scoring feature set configurable per org."
- Ava Martinez: "Agreed — tightened sandbox limits to 2s/64MB and added org-level flags in config; updated tests to assert limits."
- Priya Kapoor: "Can we ensure snippets never include destructive flags by default? Suggest adding denylist patterns."
- Ava Martinez: "Added denylist patterns to validator and a post-approval manual override flow for SREs; documented in docs/oncall/snippets.md."
- Diego Alvarez: "Score distribution looks noisy on low-volume services. Recommend a fallback to heuristic-only scoring if model confidence < 0.6."
- Ava Martinez: "Implemented confidence gating and a heuristic fallback; added telemetry to monitor model confidence over time."

CI summary:
- unit tests: pass
- integration smoke: pass
- lint: pass with minor autofixes applied
- security scan: pass (no new high/critical findings)

Deployment notes:
- feature gate: incident.runbook_executable_snippets (disabled by default)
- rollout: staged rollout to 10% of teams for 2 weeks, then further rollout after metrics validation
- rollback: feature flag and quick revert deploy available if unsafe patterns observed

Monitoring and telemetry added:
- scorer.confidence histogram, snippet-run count, snippet-run errors, per-service heuristic-fallback-rate
- alert: scorer-confidence-drop (>10% drop in week-over-week median)

Release notes for SREs: "Introduces executable, non-destructive diagnostic snippets and a telemetry scoring service that surfaces likely causal keys in incident threads. Disabled by default; enable via incident.runbook_executable_snippets. Review snippet templates before enabling in production."

Related work: builds on ENG-1012 (alert enrichment refactor) and complements recent playbook-ranking efforts.

Backwards compatibility: alert payloads now include optional fields snippets:[] and telemetry_priority:[]; consumers should ignore these if absent.

Manual testing performed: ran synthetic alerts for payment-service and storage-proxy on staging and validated snippet execution sandboxing and fallback scoring.

Known limitations:
- Model was trained on historically instrumented services; cold-start behavior for new services may favor heuristics
- Snippet authoring UI currently requires SRE role; future: allow product engineers to propose snippets with SRE review

Line items for follow-up (not in this PR):
- dataset expansion for low-volume services (ENG-1217)
- admin UI to manage denylist and org-level scoring policies
- export of snippet usage for cost analysis
